name: Chinpu Kitan
source:
Demon king is sealed in the forest. A female sage with disciple protect this forest. There is also treasure in the ruins of the Demon King's castle. Main character goes to the depths of the forest to try his luck.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
魔王被封印在森林中，一位女贤者与弟子共同守护着这片森林。魔王城的废墟里还藏着宝藏。主角深入森林，想要碰碰运气。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
